evidence.decision: Defines a collapsed route before simultaneous panes, preserves parent/detail selection and scopes tools/restoration to platform behavior.
evidence.artifact: Requires wide/intermediate/compact pane states, selection and restoration specifications or implementation.
evidence.transformation: Mail keeps mailbox/message identity while collapsing and restores the same coordinated panes on expansion.
evidence.verification: Resizes through transitions, hides/restores tools and changes parents; fails clipping, unreachable hidden panes and wrong retained detail.
evidence.applicability: Differentiates regular-width iPhone, fluid iPad, resizable/restorable Mac, TV filter/results, contextual visionOS and fullscreen Watch panes.
evidence.handoffs: Loads Sidebars, Windows or Sheets only when their navigation/window/blocking-task choice affects the pane contract.
evidence.distinctiveness: Cross-pane parent selection and collapse/restoration identity drive the concrete artifact.
